name: MainPool public calcStepIncome()
summary: MainPool.calcStepIncome(id, amount, step) was callable by anyone with arbitrary arguments and credited the caller's withdrawable income directly, so the attacker joined the game and then wrote itself an income entry it withdrew as ETH.
notes: Copycat 0x78fee339 repeated the calcStepIncome withdrawal in November 2024 with two helpers; MainPool netted +0.05 ETH in the first transaction and -0.75 ETH in the second, and the gain is not offset (rule 11). No other contract ever deposited into or withdrew from MainPool.
MainPool ETH depletion per transaction at loss.mjs prices; the attacker's 15 ETH deposit nets out in the anchor and the ticket purchases are attacker inputs to another contract.
